primary_selection: C in [0.01,0.1,1] using validation AUROC only
primary_population: origins scoreable by all primary methods; also report all scored origins and coverage
primary_metric: test AUROC; one selected model per method; 2000 participant cluster bootstrap
threshold: validation-negative 90th percentile; no test threshold tuning
strongest_control_difference: HNE AUROC minus maximum AUROC among predeclared controls; repeat control maximization inside each bootstrap draw
parameter_sensitivity: HNE-context-grid selected lambda in [0.1,1,10] and C in [0.01,0.1,1], separate from primary
family_pooling: development structural ablation only; not adopted or evaluated on test
transfer: frozen source, target-only, source-basis-zero, source-prior at fixed training-person budgets, and equal-domain pooled training; extra source data declared
test_policy: single frozen evaluation; no subsequent test-directed changes or seed selection
